The casing supports the wall of the bore right up to concreting, so it can be used safely even in silty soil with a high water content – with diameters of 80–180 cm and lengths of 15–50 (100) m. CFA is built to 22–24 m at most and is not suitable for loose, flowing soil; without support the bore would collapse, and the ground screw is only a 2–3 m element for small loads.
